cards.example_en: The drought dried the river.
cards.example_zh: 干旱使河流干涸。

cards.example_en: Before dark we should leave, since the park closes at dusk.
cards.example_zh: 天黑前我们应该离开，因为公园在黄昏关门。

cards.example_en: Throw the empty bottles into the dustbin beside the gate.
cards.example_zh: 把空瓶子扔进大门旁边的垃圾箱。

cards.example_en: Take the elevator to the fifth floor if your bags are heavy.
cards.example_zh: 如果行李很重，就乘电梯上五楼。

cards.example_en: Meet me at the main entrance.
cards.example_zh: 在正门与我见面。

cards.example_en: Write a new entry in your diary.
cards.example_zh: 在日记里写一条新内容。

cards.example_en: Put the letter in an envelope.
cards.example_zh: 把信放进信封。

cards.example_en: Both teams had equal numbers of players after the change.
cards.example_zh: 调整之后，两队的球员人数相等。

cards.example_en: Our school teaches equality so every student is treated fairly.
cards.example_zh: 我们学校教导平等，所以每个学生都得到公平对待。

cards.example_en: Staff will equip each lab group with gloves and safety glasses.
cards.example_zh: 工作人员会给每个实验小组配备手套和护目镜。

cards.example_en: You don't need much equipment to go running.
cards.example_zh: 您不需要太多设备就可以跑步。

cards.example_en: An error in the timetable sent our class to the wrong room.
cards.example_zh: 时间表上的一处错误让我们班走错了教室。

cards.example_en: The hamster tried to escape from its small cage.
cards.example_zh: 那只仓鼠试图从自己的小笼子里逃走。

cards.example_en: I rewrote the essay after I noticed the conclusion did not match the question.
cards.example_zh: 我发现结论和题目对不上，就把这篇作文重写了。

cards.example_en: Measure the exact length of the table before buying the cloth.
cards.example_zh: 买桌布之前，先量一量桌子的准确长度。

cards.example_en: The art exhibition opens on Friday.
cards.example_zh: 美术展览周五开幕。

cards.example_en: Wild pandas exist mainly in the mountains of Sichuan.
cards.example_zh: 野生大熊猫主要存在于四川的山区。

cards.example_en: After one song played everywhere, the young singer rose to fame.
cards.example_zh: 一首歌到处播放之后，这位年轻歌手出了名。

cards.example_en: Golden wheat covered the farmland all the way to the hills.
cards.example_zh: 金黄的麦子覆盖着农田，一直延伸到山边。

cards.example_en: Always fasten your seat belt before the bus leaves the stop.
cards.example_zh: 公交车离开车站前，一定要系好安全带。

cards.example_en: Helping classmates every day earned her the teacher's favour.
cards.example_zh: 她天天帮助同学，赢得了老师的好感。

cards.example_en: On Friday the office sent a fax to confirm our hotel rooms.
cards.example_zh: 星期五，办公室发了传真来确认我们的酒店房间。

cards.example_en: On Sundays, students can enter the federal museum in the capital free.
cards.example_zh: 周日，学生可以免费进入首都的联邦博物馆。

cards.example_en: The zoo charges a small fee for students on weekends.
cards.example_zh: 动物园在周末向学生收取少量费用。

cards.example_en: We sat by the fireplace and drank tea on the snowy evening.
cards.example_zh: 下雪的晚上，我们坐在壁炉边喝茶。

cards.example_en: He is fond of classical music.
cards.example_zh: 他喜欢古典音乐。

cards.example_en: The captain insists that discipline is the foundation of winning.
cards.example_zh: 船长坚持认为纪律是获胜的基础。

cards.example_en: Would you like some fruit juice with your sandwich at lunch?
cards.example_zh: 午饭时，你想就着三明治喝点果汁吗？

cards.example_en: We studied circles in geometry.
cards.example_zh: 我们在几何课上学习圆。

cards.example_en: They play golf on Sunday mornings.
cards.example_zh: 他们周日早上打高尔夫。

cards.example_en: The weather gradually got warmer.
cards.example_zh: 天气渐渐暖和起来。

cards.example_en: Warm weather quickened the growth of the beans we planted.
cards.example_zh: 暖和的天气让我们种的豆子长得更快。

cards.example_en: Before the class photo next Wednesday, I need a haircut.
cards.example_zh: 下周三拍班级合影之前，我需要理个发。

cards.example_en: After class, hardworking students stayed to finish the group project.
cards.example_zh: 下课后，勤劳的学生留下来完成小组项目。

cards.example_en: The rice harvest begins in autumn.
cards.example_zh: 水稻在秋天收割。

cards.example_en: On Friday evening, our headmaster spoke to parents in the hall.
cards.example_zh: 周五晚上，我们的校长在礼堂里对家长讲话。

cards.example_en: After the spring concert, our headmistress praised the school choir.
cards.example_zh: 春季音乐会结束后，我们的女校长表扬了学校合唱队。

cards.example_en: Our headteacher greeted every student at the school gate.
cards.example_zh: 我们的校长在校门口迎接每一位学生。

cards.example_en: Hey! Your book is on the floor.
cards.example_zh: 嘿！你的书掉在地上了。

cards.example_en: From our town to the city, the new highway shortens the trip.
cards.example_zh: 从我们镇上到城里，新公路缩短了路程。

cards.example_en: Many people return to their homeland during the Spring Festival.
cards.example_zh: 许多人在春节期间回到自己的家乡。

cards.example_en: My neighbour is a housewife who cooks lunch for her family every day.
cards.example_zh: 我的邻居是家庭主妇，每天给家人做午饭。

cards.example_en: After the long hike, hunger made us look for a small restaurant.
cards.example_zh: 长途徒步之后，饥饿让我们去找一家小餐馆。

cards.example_en: This idiom means to start again.
cards.example_zh: 这条习语的意思是重新开始。

cards.example_en: The story is indeed true.
cards.example_zh: 这个故事确实是真的。

cards.example_en: Mum will insist on warm coats in this cold wind.
cards.example_zh: 风这么冷，妈妈一定会坚持让我们穿厚外套。

cards.example_en: Teachers will inspect our classrooms before the visitors arrive tomorrow.
cards.example_zh: 明天来宾到达之前，老师会检查我们的教室。

cards.example_en: Uncle drove his jeep along the muddy road to the village.
cards.example_zh: 叔叔开着吉普车，沿着泥泞的路驶向村子。

cards.example_en: She works as a journalist for a newspaper.
cards.example_zh: 她是一家报纸的记者。

cards.example_en: Buy one kilogram of apples on your way home from school today.
cards.example_zh: 今天放学回家的路上，买一千克苹果。

word.example_en: Grandma is fond of morning walks.
